questions.question: Which formula correctly calculates a loading dose?
choices: Loading dose (mg/kg) = Target level (mg/L) ÷ Volume of distribution (L/kg)
Loading dose (mg/kg) = Elimination half-life (hr) × Target level (mg/L)
Loading dose (mg/kg) = Volume of distribution (L/kg) * Target level (mg/L)
questions.answer: Loading dose (mg/kg) = Volume of distribution (L/kg) * Target level (mg/L)
